source_snapshot.procedure: Run `ipmitool user list <Channel number>` after generic prechecks/log clearing.
source_snapshot.criteria: The user account list is displayed correctly.
source_snapshot.script: Internal `useraccount_check-add-set` path whose name suggests broader add/set behavior.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES recognizes a read-only inventory but omits the required channel, hardcodes cipher suite 17, exposes the password with `-P`, covers one implicit channel and does not normalize access/privilege columns or distinguish empty, unauthorized and transport failures.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE with MEDIUM read-only risk correctly requires supported-channel discovery, separate complete `user list <channel>` reads, protected credentials, untruncated raw output, slot/access/privilege normalization, redaction and a strict no-write boundary.

old_problem: IPMI user access is channel-scoped, but DeepSeek drops the source's channel parameter and assumes one implicit current channel. A command success or one list cannot prove full relevant-channel coverage or correct Call-in/Link Auth/IPMI Msg/Channel Priv Limit fields. The referenced internal script appears to include add/set behavior and cannot be trusted for this read-only case without a pinned inspection.
disposition_reason: Use direct pinned ipmitool read-only `user list <channel>` calls for every Project-declared session-capable management channel, preserve complete raw output, normalize every slot/access field, correlate with an approved channel/slot baseline and separate empty/unauthorized/transport errors. Target channels and schema are runtime configuration. The broad internal script is excluded unless an exact revision is reviewed and proven read-only; no user confirmation is required for the approved read contract.
decision_basis: XLSX row 939, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, adjacent WebUI-Modify/IPMI-Add rows and preserved V3.1 record were directly reviewed; row 940 and its manifest identity were independently verified.

Upstream ipmitool source defines `user list [<channel number>]`, defaults omission to current channel `0x0E`, and retrieves per-channel user access plus name for all slots. The explicit source channel must therefore be supplied and recorded.
The upstream output fields are ID, Name, Callin, Link Auth, IPMI Msg and Channel Priv Limit; correctness requires field normalization and an authorized expected matrix, not merely printable output.
ED-03/ED-13 and ED-33 through ED-38 allow a parameterized read-only command contract while forbidding write-script substitution and separating review completion from DUT verdict.

test_case.test_name: Inventory and validate every relevant IPMI user slot per explicit management channel
test_case.purpose: Verify through direct read-only ipmitool calls that every user slot on each Project-declared supported management channel is completely displayed with the correct username, empty/used state, Call-in, Link Authentication, IPMI Messaging and channel privilege limit, while distinguishing channel/error conditions and making no account or channel change.
required_package: Target BMC/firmware identity, pinned supported ipmitool version and protected RMCP+ access
Project/vendor list of relevant supported management channel numbers or an approved read-only channel-capability discovery method
Authoritative per-channel user-slot baseline including maximum/used slots, username/redaction token, Call-in, Link Auth, IPMI Msg and privilege limit
Target privilege vocabulary, empty/fixed/disabled slot semantics and any documented WebUI/Redfish-to-IPMI identity mapping
Protected credential prompt/provider that avoids `-P` process exposure, approved cipher negotiation/policy and metadata redaction rules
Complete raw plus normalized evidence store; the internal add-set script remains prohibited unless pinned and independently proven list-only
test_case.test_command: READ ONLY. Verify target identity, pinned ipmitool and protected RMCP+ credential handling; do not hard-code cipher suite 17 unless target policy explicitly selects it. Preserve logs rather than clearing them. Establish the complete relevant channel set using Project/vendor data or approved read-only channel discovery. For each explicit channel, run `ipmitool ... user list <channel>` without `-P`, capture complete untruncated raw output/status and normalize every slot into channel, ID, redacted name, Call-in, Link Auth, IPMI Msg, Channel Priv Limit and empty/used state. Compare to the approved per-channel baseline and optional read-only account mapping, keeping empty list/slot, invalid channel, insufficient privilege, authentication and transport errors distinct. Repeat only read-only fingerprints to prove no change. Do not execute the broad `useraccount_check-add-set` script or any user set/password/enable/disable/priv/channel setaccess/SOL payload command.
test_case.expected_result: Every relevant supported channel has a complete slot inventory; each slot's ID, username identity token, empty/used state and all access/privilege columns match the approved channel baseline. Invalid/unsupported channels and authentication/transport failures are classified separately rather than as empty accounts. Optional identity correlation is documented without collapsing channel-specific flags. Pre/post inventories and audit context show no user, channel or session configuration change.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires explicit complete channel coverage, verified target/tool, complete raw per-channel output, normalized every-slot fields, equality to the authorized baseline, distinct error interpretation, protected credentials and no-change proof. A channel-less call, one assumed channel, command exit or generic output cannot pass. Missing channels/slots, wrong access/privilege/name state, incomplete output, untrusted credentials, ambiguous errors or any write invocation is FAIL and stops. Missing channel/schema/baseline access is NOT READY; no user confirmation is needed for the approved read-only collection.
safety_gate: Use direct read-only `user list <channel>` and protected credential handling; never place BMC passwords in `-P`, logs, processes, screenshots or records.
Supply and record every channel explicitly; do not treat current-channel `0x0E` or one LAN channel as universal coverage.
Do not execute the broader add-set script unless its exact revision is reviewed and all write paths are excluded for this case.
Do not issue user set/password/enable/disable/priv, channel setaccess, SOL payload or any other account/channel write, and do not clear logs.
Stop on wrong target, unknown channel/field semantics, incomplete output, sensitive-data exposure or inability to distinguish empty from authorization/transport failure.
expected_evidence: Target BMC/firmware, pinned ipmitool version, protected interface/cipher policy and complete relevant channel set
Complete raw redacted `user list <channel>` output/status/hash for every explicit channel
Normalized channel-slot matrix covering ID/name, empty/used, Call-in, Link Auth, IPMI Msg and privilege limit
Authorized baseline comparison and distinct invalid-channel/empty/authorization/authentication/transport interpretations
Pre/post no-change/audit proof, excluded write-script evidence and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is intended. On wrong target/channel, unexpected write path, incomplete schema or sensitive-data exposure, stop, preserve/redact the first raw evidence and close the IPMI session. Do not run user/account writes to populate or repair the list; escalate channel/schema discrepancies to the owner.
